about: Condi's five-weapon SFX handoff for Prod's isolated range. Candidate audio, not approved. Every file is 48 kHz, 16-bit PCM, stereo WAV under wav/. Times are seconds.
level_contract: Files are already level-matched: every weapon's main fire event reads -21 LUFS (loudest 400 ms). Play all of them through one SFX bus at the same volume_db and trim that bus, not individual players, so the comparison stays fair. Suggested starting point: volume_db 0 on each player, bus at 0 dB, then one global trim by ear.
player_hint: Player's own gun: AudioStreamPlayer (non-positional). Impacts: AudioStreamPlayer3D at the hit point. The files start within 1-5 ms of the event; no pre-roll to compensate.

events.note: Designed for 0.65-0.8 s cadence; previous tail is 50 dB down at 0.72 s.
Bolt reset clicks are baked in at +0.13 s and +0.18 s, inside the 0.30-0.40 s cadence.

events.trigger: every round; alternate A, B, A, B
events.note: Matched as a series: a held 7.5 rounds/s burst reads -21 LUFS like the other guns, so a single round is quieter (-25.7) by design. Do not play a tail per round.

events.trigger: trigger released after 2 or more rounds
events.note: The room decay and bolt settling that the per-round files leave out.

events.trigger: the shot frame, once per trigger (not per pellet)
start of the pump/return animation (0.35 s after fire in the demo)
events.note: Back stroke at 0, forward lock at +0.18 s. Line the forward lock up with the visible slam.
Rises for 1.2 s. If released early, stop it with a 20-30 ms fade (Tween volume_db) and play massdriver.release_early.
Seamless loop. Start it as massdriver.charge reaches its top (1.2 s); a 50 ms crossfade hides the hand-off.
Stop charge/charge_hold with a 20-30 ms fade on the same frame.
2 dB quieter and shorter than the full release.

events.trigger: start of recovery, about 0.45-0.55 s after release
a resolved hit on a metal-tagged surface
a resolved hit on an organic dummy
events.note: No metal ring, no sparkle: a muffled body thud.
Replaces impact.metal for the Driver; residual plate buzz.
Residual rubble rumble and falling chips.
Deep thud and a short low thrum; mostly below 300 Hz, so it will be quiet on laptop speakers.

impact_rules.unknown_surface: No sound file is a safe universal fallback. Suggest impact.stone, and log the untagged collider, as 02_EFFECTS asks.
impact_rules.per_weapon: Foundry, Sightline, Switchback and Bulkhead share impact.* files. Switchback: play impacts 5-6 dB below the others (or every other round) so 7.5 hits/s don't wash out. Bulkhead: one impact for the central blast, plus at most two extra pellet impacts 10-14 dB down with 4-13 ms offsets, as in the demo.
impact_rules.level: Impact files sit 4 dB under the fire files (-25 LUFS); Mass Driver impacts sit 2 dB under (-23 LUFS). 3D distance attenuation comes on top.
